name: CalibratedMath
why_it_matters: Reporters need AI tools that flag when they are unsure so non-expert users do not treat confident-sounding answers as verified facts.
task_shape: Models answer arithmetic questions across varied difficulty levels and must express calibrated confidence in their answers, either as numeric probabilities or in natural language words, which are then scored against actual accuracy.
signals: Directly measures whether a model's stated confidence matches its real accuracy, a key safety property for newsroom use.
Limited to math problems, so results may not generalize to confidence calibration in open-ended research or fact-checking.

source.label: Lin, Hilton, Evans — Teaching Models to Express Their Uncertainty in Words (arXiv)
